name: Patrick Mahomes

background.fact: Patrick Mahomes was born September 17, 1995, and played at Whitehouse High School in Whitehouse, Texas, before going to Texas Tech.
The Chiefs drafted him 10th overall in 2017, and he has played only for Kansas City (jersey 15).
He has won two NFL MVP awards (2018, 2022) and three Super Bowl MVPs (2019, 2022, 2023).
His contract signed in 2020 is listed at 10 years and 450 million dollars, 45 million a year.
His father Pat Mahomes was a Major League Baseball pitcher, and Mahomes credits years of baseball with building his arm strength.
His combine 40-yard time is listed at 4.8 seconds, so he is a good but not elite runner; the Madden 2026 week 8 overall rating is 97.

family.fact: His father is former MLB pitcher Pat Mahomes and his mother is Randi Martin; the parents divorced in 2006.
His younger brother Jackson is a social media influencer, and a half-brother, Graham Walker, plays football at Rice University.
He is the godson of former MLB pitcher LaTroy Hawkins, a teammate of his father with the Minnesota Twins.
He married his high school sweetheart Brittany Matthews on March 12, 2022; she co-owns the Kansas City Current soccer club.
The couple announced on November 10, 2026 that they are expecting a fourth child; they already have Sterling (Feb 2021), Bronze (Nov 2022) and Golden (Jan 2025).

recent_events.fact: Mahomes hurt his right elbow on a strip-sack late in the first half of the 35-12 win over the Jets on Nov 8 but did not miss a snap; he finished 23 of 31 for 242 yards and 2 touchdowns.
An MRI showed an elbow strain or sprain with no significant damage; Andy Reid called it minor and day-to-day.
Mahomes had full practice participation all four days of Week 10 prep and carries no game designation for Sunday at Atlanta.
The Chiefs traded for wide receiver Josh Downs from the Colts at the deadline; he is expected to play Sunday, per Reid.
Kansas City snapped a two-game losing streak against the Jets; the losses were 28-24 at Denver on Nov 1 (a penalty wiped out a late winning touchdown) and 2026 Week 7 at Seattle.
Mahomes and Travis Kelce set the NFL record for QB-TE combined passing and receiving yards (9,360) in the Jets game.
Headlines this week include an analyst arguing Mahomes is no longer in the top QB tier and a Yahoo list that moved him off the top of its player rankings; both are opinion pieces.

quotes.fact: Mahomes said Wednesday the elbow is in a better spot than after the game and that he expects to be available Sunday.
Mahomes said that after talking to the doctors he feels he is in a great spot, and his focus is pain management.
Mahomes said swelling affected his throws in the second half against the Jets and that being able to throw convinced him it was muscular, not ligament damage.
Reid said Mahomes is in good spirits and the work is rehab and easing soreness.
Mahomes praised Downs' mindset after meeting him (NBC Sports headline: 'You can tell the intellect', Nov 12); full article not read.

team_context.fact: Kansas City is 6-2, scoring 25.2 and allowing 17.9 points per game, and sits a half-game behind Denver (7-2) in the AFC West.
Kenneth Walker III has 10 touchdowns (a career high) and gave Mahomes a real run threat; Mahomes is using play action 34.2% and snaps under center 40.1%, both career highs.
Walker is hurt: ESPN said questionable (groin) on Nov 13, but the Chiefs' injury page shows him out after missing Friday and Saturday practice.
Right tackle Jaylon Moore (ankle) is ruled out; Josh Ezeudu replaced him in the Jets game.
Xavier Worthy left the Jets game with a hamstring injury but practiced fully all week; Rashee Rice (knee) and Kelce (ankle) also practiced fully.
Mahomes's throws are short: air yards per attempt were 5.0 or lower in four straight starts, and only 27.8% of passes went 10+ yards in the Jets game, a career low.
His season line: 177 of 263 for 2,037 yards, 14 touchdowns, 4 interceptions, 11 sacks, 17.75 fantasy points a game.
He faced two-high coverage 48.8% of the time, the highest of his career, which explains the short game.

next_opponent.fact: Kansas City plays at Atlanta on Sunday Nov 15, 1 pm ET, in the indoor Mercedes-Benz Stadium; line KC -3 (SI listed -3.5), total 47.5 in the data (45.5 at SI on Nov 10).
Atlanta is 3-6 (1-4 at home) and lost 16-0 to Tampa Bay and 34-17 to Cincinnati in the last two games.
The Falcons allow 15.2 passing points per game (21st) and do poorly against play action (74.4% completions, 30th) and unpressured throws (75.9%, 29th).
Atlanta's defensive success rate fell from 63.9% (2nd) in its first four games to 52.9% (30th) in the last four.
Atlanta traded safety Jessie Bates III to Jacksonville on Nov 9 for a 2027 second and a 2028 fifth; he graded as PFF's fourth-best safety.
Xavier Watts replaces much of Bates' role but has struggled in coverage this season; DeMarcco Hellams is next man up per coach Kevin Stefanski.
Falcons pass rushers James Pearce Jr. (back) and Gervon Dexter (illness) are questionable, and linebacker Divine Deablo (forearm) is doubtful.

style.fact: Wikipedia describes him as a pass-first, dual-threat passer known for arm strength, pocket elusiveness and innovative throws such as no-look and behind-the-back passes.
Madden 2026 lists throw power 97, short accuracy 98, mid accuracy 94, deep accuracy 84 and throw-on-the-run 97, so deep accuracy is his weakest passing grade.
Wikipedia notes he is credited with unusual timing and the ability to use athleticism to fool defenders, which suits a short, quick offense.
Known weakness this season: fewer downfield shots and a 35.6% pressure rate on a line missing its right tackle.

availability.detail: Right elbow strain from the Jets game; full practice all week and no designation for Sunday at Atlanta.

reasons: He practiced fully and has no designation, so the elbow is a small risk (chiefs.com, Nov 14).
Atlanta allows 15.2 passing points a game (21st) and is weak against play action and unpressured throws, which fits KC's offense.
Right tackle Jaylon Moore is out and Kenneth Walker may be out, which takes away the play-action run threat that powered the offense.
His average is 17.75 fantasy points over 8 games with a range of 6.0 to 28.98; the offense throws short with low air yards, capping the ceiling.
Kansas City is a 3-point favorite in a dome, so game script should be neutral to slightly positive.
